text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 5xx + timeouts on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Error rate spiked to ~18% over 1m, latency p95 > 10s. Paging on-call: @sam oncall.

sam oncall: I see alerts. On it. Any regional pattern?

incident-bot: Metrics: 5xx spike concentrated on gw-usw2 and scheduler-pool-3. Queue depth for batcher increased from 30 -> 120 in 3m. Head-of-line blocking observed for long-seq requests.

jess: I'm on call too, jumping in. Noted increase in long-running requests (seq_len > 2048) after yesterday's quantize rollout. Could be causing runaway windowing in the batcher.

maria-sre: Confirming logs show repeated KV cache misses and backlog on scheduler. Sample from gateway logs:

``` 
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z gw-usw2: handler.go:212 error="upstream timeout" req_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=504
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z scheduler: batcher.go:987 warning="batch window extended" size=96 avg_seq=2100 pool=3
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z runtime: kvcache.go:154 info="evicting older entries" keys=512 miss_rate=0.78
```

lee-deploy: I'm seeing the same on infra dashboards. Autoscaler hasn't triggered due to pool capacity limits (reserved GPUs at quota). Can we open capacity or reroute?

support-ops: CS reports ~12 customers seeing generation timeouts. One enterprise customer reported degraded UX and began routing to fallback.

sam oncall: First mitigation: enable temporary ingress throttling for seq_len > 1024 to stop new long requests from entering the main queue. Also enable model-fallback policy to a smaller variant for non-SLA traffic. I’ll post the commands.

sam oncall: Run on gateway:
```
# throttle large-seqs for 15m
rctlctl set-rate-limit --route /v1/generate --predicate "input.tokens > 1024" --rate 50/s --duration 15m
# enable fallback
redwoodctl rollout set-fallback --route /v1/generate --from=redwood/large-llm --to=redwood/small-llm --pct=30
```

jess: Applying throttle now. Pushing fallback rollout to 40% (non-SLA traffic).

lee-deploy: I opened a temporary dedicated pool (dedicated-pool-temp-9) with 4x GPUs in us-west-2 and added it to the routing table as overflow. Command: `redwoodctl infra add-pool --name dedicated-pool-temp-9 --zone usw2 --gpus 4`

maria-sre: Starting to drain scheduler-pool-3 into dedicated-pool-temp-9 via routed policy. Watch queue depth; if p95 latency doesn't come down in 2m we'll evict oldest queued requests.

support-ops: Notifying affected customers and offering workaround (reduce max_tokens) — CS note: "We're investigating; fallback enabled; ETA 15-30m" :white_check_mark:

customersuccess-bot: Customer impact summary: ~12 active customer sessions affected, peak error volume impacting ~4% of total requests globally but 18% within us-west-2. No billing anomalies yet.

sam oncall: Observability checks: run `redwoodctl metrics query "batcher.queue_depth{pool='3'}[5m]"` and `redwoodctl logs tail scheduler --filter "batch window"`

jess: Results: queue_depth dropped from 120 -> 40 after throttle + fallback + new pool. 5xx rate down to ~3% in 4m. p95 latency fell from 10s -> 2.2s. Good signal.

maria-sre: Root-cause hypothesis: quantization rollout changed tokenization/seq-length distribution for a subset of traffic, increasing average sequence length and causing continuous expansion of batching windows. The batcher algorithm's growth heuristic didn't hit the eviction threshold fast enough, so head-of-line long requests held many small requests hostage.

lee-deploy: Action items: revert quantize change for the model variant (if we can pinpoint rollout flag) and add quick guard to batcher: max-window-time 300ms and a hard cap on batch size 64 for mixed traffic.

sam oncall: I'll coordinate with model team. For now we'll keep throttle active for another 10m and monitor. Also enabling automatic eviction policy: `batcherctl set-policy --pool 3 --eviction oldest --threshold 80`

support-ops: CS updated customers with timeline and mitigation steps. No escalations to execs yet.

jess: Note to on-call: add a follow-up postmortem to incidents channel with timeline and exact metric snapshots. Tagging @maria-sre to lead RCA.

maria-sre: Will do. Preliminary RCA note: quantize rollout -> shift in token counts -> extended batch windows -> HOL blocking -> gateway timeouts. Next steps: add metric alert for avg_seq_len spikes, add batcher guard rails, and auto-fallback for model variants when queue depth exceeds threshold.

sam oncall: Final status: mitigation in place, service healthy in us-west-2, ongoing monitoring for 30m. If stable, we'll close and file postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved flag set by sam oncall at 2026-03-15T10:14:27Z."
